proposed.explanation: Analog systems actually suffer from range limitations and cabling challenges; IP systems leverage existing network infrastructure. While analog systems have lower initial cost, IP systems offer superior integration and reduced installation complexity that offsets this advantage. Both IP and analog systems require proper power management in Philippine facilities due to voltage fluctuations; this is not a differentiating factor. IP intercoms transmit audio and video over existing Ethernet infrastructure, reducing cabling requirements compared to dedicated analog pairs. They integrate seamlessly with modern access control systems and Building Management Systems, providing a unified platform for security operations. IP intercoms are preferred in modern buildings because they leverage existing network infrastructure and provide seamless integration with access control and BMS systems.
